title: Recursive quantified matrix truth
statement: Given a CNF matrix $m$ over natural-number variables, a list of quantifier kinds, an assignment $\sigma:\mathbb N\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and a starting index $i\in\mathbb N$, define truth recursively. For an empty quantifier list, the condition is that $m$ evaluates to true under $\sigma$. For an existential quantifier followed by a list $qs$, some Boolean value $b$ must make the recursive condition hold for $qs$ with variable $i$ updated to $b$ and index $i+1$; for a universal quantifier, that condition must hold for both Boolean values $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF matrix over natural-number variables
